name: Tales of Meadows
detailed_description:
Tales of Meadows is an action-adventure game set in the medieval town of Turov, recreated based on historical data by the small Belarusian team Qualestory Games.

After years of training under his guardian Peresvet, young Philipp returns to his hometown of Turov. He dreams of joining the local prince's retinue, becoming a mighty warrior. But upon arriving, Philipp finds a depressing sight: the principality has lost its former glory, the people are gripped by fear, and pagans have settled in the forests, offering prayers to an ancient, long-forgotten deity and performing human sacrifices.

🛠 Key Features:

  • AAA-level graphics and sound

We maximize Unreal Engine 5 to immerse you in a realistic world of the High Middle Ages and capture the beauty of Turov's surroundings and the horrors within.

  • Deeply developed plot

Philipp's story is full of contradictions, controversial decisions, and upheavals that affect and change the protagonist. You will change with him.

  • Interface-free gameplay

Navigate using conversations with locals and their hints, and notes describing your target's location. The environment is your tool.

  • Historically recreated town of Turov

Our team meticulously recreates Turov, striving to depict it as it truly was. We collaborate with local museums and historical consultants.

short_description: You are Philip, a young warrior who will have to face the difficulties of life in a city destroyed by Tatar-Mongol raids. But the most important problem is the pagans, hiding in the forests and robbing ordinary people. Save people, return greatness to the principality, become a legend!
